newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian interbank rates stable on high liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Croatian interbank rates stable on high liquidity.

text.p: Croatian interbank rates were steady to slightly lower amid high liquidity on Thursday morning in the local money market, dealers said.
They said banks' accounts were replenished after the state pension fund began repaying loans it took from them earlier this month.
Relatively weak demand left a ten-million kuna surplus in supply.
All of the morning's 21.5 million kuna were call money borrowings. Most deals were struck at 10.5 percent, except one smaller loan at 10 percent.
Overnight trade on Wednesady was modest at 4.4 million kuna, borrowed by two banks with shortfalls.
